name: container-text-flip

frames.best_why: Longest word fully sharp and centred in its widened slab after the blur transition.

tagline: A word swaps out letter by letter inside a slab that resizes to fit.
summary: An animated headline that cycles through a list of words. Each word blurs in letter by letter while the slab behind it smoothly changes width.
appearance: A short white headline sits above a raised rounded slab on a dark stage. The slab has a subtle slate gradient, a thin inset edge and a soft shadow, and holds one large bold white word. Its width grows and shrinks with the word.
behaviour: Every few seconds the word swaps for the next in the list: new letters blur in one after another, the slab eases out or in to the new width, and old letters blur away. It loops endlessly.
demo_content: Headline "Build things that are", cycling the words better, faster, beautiful, modern and awesome.
search_phrases: container that grows with the word
use_when: A hero or section headline should cycle a few adjectives to keep an otherwise static page alive.
avoid_when: It loops forever with no pause control, so it distracts on reading-heavy pages or where reduced motion is needed.
customise: Words, interval and animation duration are props; the slab's gradient, inset edge and shadow are hardcoded classes you edit for a different skin.
weight_why: A handful of letter spans and one layout animation on a timer; little idle work.

a11y.note: The word changes on a timer with no pause and no reduced-motion check, which can bother readers; there are no controls.

issues: Cycles on a timer with no way to pause or step through the words.
polish_why: Smooth width and blur choreography; the inset-shadow slab styling feels a little dated.
title: Container Text Flip
